mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Reddan Soccer Park and a waning crescent moon overhead. The air quality index is currently at 52, which is in the moderate range. Expect an overnight low of 70 degrees with some rain predicted as we head into the early morning hours.

City officials are currently focused on several upcoming developments. The Plan Commission has site plans for 201 South Main Street and an initial review for Sub-Zero in the Liberty Business Park on their agenda for September 8.

There is plenty to do this week. You can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, local options include Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can also enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and live music this Wednesday.

Reviewing the police department report, an officer observed a driver speeding and acting erratically on August 6. Upon investigation, the driver was arrested for his fourth O W I offence and booked into jail.
Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. The restaurant is open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
